column1: # Display names and search aliases for the finder (Compose, then Tab).
# One line per character: chars TAB display TAB alias|alias|...
#  - chars: one output, or a lower/Upper pair written "ø/Ø".
#  - display: the name shown in the list, at most 24 characters; a pair has
#    "lower/Upper" names; "-" keeps the name derived from Unicode's.
#  - aliases: what people might type to find it; every word and phrase is
#    searchable. Unicode's own name, synonyms of its words (DIAERESIS gives
#    umlaut, ...), the general category and the Compose Compose name are added
#    by tools/gen-sequences.py, so they need not be repeated here.
# People do not agree on names, so be generous with aliases. Every character
# listed must be in the table: the build stops otherwise.
